title: Unified Cross-Modal Retrieval for Media Archives
business: Digital media archives and content management platforms that need to search across diverse file types.
problem: Traditional search systems rely on metadata tags, which fail when users search for content using a different modality, such as finding a video clip by describing its visual content or searching for a specific audio segment using a text query.
solution: Gemini Embedding 2 Preview enables the mapping of text, images, video, audio, and PDFs into a single, unified embedding space, allowing for semantic retrieval where a text query can successfully match non-text media assets.
steps: Ingest diverse media assets including video, audio, and PDF documents into the storage system.
Pass each asset through the Gemini Embedding 2 Preview endpoint to generate high-dimensional vector representations.
Store the resulting vectors in a vector database to maintain the unified semantic space.
Convert user search queries into vectors using the same embedding model to perform similarity searches across the unified index.
outcome: Users can perform intuitive, cross-modal searches, retrieving relevant video or audio segments based on descriptive text queries without relying on manual tagging.
limitation: As a preview model, Gemini Embedding 2 Preview may have more restrictive rate limits compared to stable models, which should be monitored via API response headers.
